timing: Written after inspecting the V14 routing run; this is a prospective publication guard and a descriptive audit, not a new preregistered efficacy experiment.
selection: Use the recorded calibration-only SELECTION.json. Keep-family and merge candidates remain eligible. Never choose a new structure using held labels.
merge_admission: Calibration selection may choose merge. A selected merge is compared with the best keep candidate, never itself. Publication still requires candidate-bound noninferiority/retention and positive net value; no child parameter averaging.
selective_service_guard: Where selective results exist, require no actual-output, accepted-coverage or OOD-rejection regression against the same retained alternative. Paired held request IDs must match.
cost_accounting: Count each parent training stage once, each split training stage once, partition search, all four crossfit calibration fits and final refit. Child nested seconds are not added again. Saved raw/calibrated snapshots share trained networks but occupy separate artifact bytes in the executed experiment. Count shared encoder artifact/load/encoding once. The original process receipt measures entire routing-command wall/CPU/peak RSS and runner-wide network; these totals include unseparated serialization/calibration/diagnostic/executor work and must not be added to component times again. Original artifact inventory supplies source/cache/output file bytes. Per-component resource breakdown, energy, billing, deployment queues and resident object overhead remain unmeasured. Numerical bytes are not total serving or economic cost.
selection_cost_audit: The original centroid parameter_count=0 field means the generic weights accessor did not count prototype state: there are 4608 learned-from-training prototype coefficients plus 12 labels. BM25 numerical bytes omit dictionaries. Keep the executed source unchanged and qualify these counters. Centroid wins calibration strictly, so the incomplete byte tie-break did not determine this winner.
isolation_attribution: The isolated experiment itself uses fixed skill/project partitions. Preserved skills and current-source fallback demonstrate that implemented service policy; they do not establish learned gradient splitting, compression, or superiority to exact current project storage.
comparison_limits: Routing uses newly authored V14 language; isolation reuses V13 fixtures. Do not pool their requests or compare different-host wall times as paired speedups. All isolation runs use the same qualified seed-713 skill model; project-seed repeats are not independent skill evaluations.
authority: The guard is a research caller check; it is not a production installation grant. require_structural_admission raises on rejected or incomplete evidence.
